name: acryl-web-server
description: The webServer port of a framework-hosted app: the node request/upgrade interface DSH's driver rows register on, backed by acryl-node-server's raw routes. Ours, so the chat driver's connection and gateway run on our host without DSH's web server.
mount: mount it before the DSH driver rows that inject webServer (the chat connection and its gateway); the framework's page serving applies its index taps
